score_notes.christology: We want to help people find and follow Jesus!
score_notes.scripture: equip them with the truth of God’s word
score_notes.soteriology: Through the gospel's transformative message, we aim to address their physical, emotional, and spiritual needs with God's grace and guidance.
score_notes.preaching: hearing and responding to gospel-centered preaching and teaching
score_notes.mission: O’side Church exists to make disciples of Jesus who love God and love people.
score_notes.cultural: Our vision is to be a church that serves as a resource to help meet the needs of the people of our community. We want to see lives and our community transformed by God’s love, and serve as a catalyst for God’s Kingdom purposes in the city of Oceanside and beyond.
